stem: Read lines 1 through 3 from the poem “Maple Street.”
instruction: These lines suggest that the speaker thinks —

options.label: A
options.text: the maple tree is the most noticeable object on the street

options.label: B
options.text: streets should be named after features found near them

options.label: C
options.text: the street originally had a different name

options.label: D
options.text: people disagree about the meaning of the street’s name
